title: Flash-Fusion
headline: Structured natural-language analysis for IoT sensor streams
summary: Flash-Fusion turns natural-language requests over sensor data into typed plans, validates them against schemas, and executes deterministic operators. Its benchmark artifacts, inspection traces, and reusable query pipeline support paper-oriented research on low-latency, auditable sensor analysis.
problem: Natural-language analysis over IoT streams must translate open-ended requests into bounded data operations without losing reproducibility or inspection context.
contribution: A reusable route, plan, validate, execute, and inspect pipeline with typed schemas, deterministic pandas operators, and an optional skeleton-cache path.
pipeline: Route the request into a supported analysis path.
Validate the plan against data and operation schemas.
Execute deterministic operators and retain an inspection trace.
evidence: Benchmark driver and output conventions in run_benchmark.sh.
Public preprint and hosted research demo.
limitations: This is active research. The public demo and committed benchmark artifacts reflect the current prototype and may change as evaluation continues.
